audit_comment: THE DRAGON ISSUE-18 OPENER PART TWO - the three variant chains. CHAIN ONE, New Spells in D&D by Paul Sullin (print 13, PDF 15): nineteen researched spells across levels one to six, the per-level counts 1/2/4/4/2/6 - Nature Call (the 1-10 summons, the minus-two hit die, the eagle messenger, the 1-4 turn arrival, no underground), Magic Missile II (one +2 or two +1 arrows per five levels beyond third), Moon Runes (the one-year shine and fade), Flamebolt (3-24 living, 3-30 undead, the 5-foot ignition, the level plus 1-3 fires), Mystic Rope (100 feet, one point per four feet, the one-foot regeneration), Pit of Flame (the 20x20x5 pit, half level rounded up, the 3-dice fifth-level example, the interrogation float), Word of Warding (usable while meled, one melee turn, the third-level ceiling after immediate use), Force Field (the ten-foot sphere that will not block magic), the Extend family (levels 3/4/5 at 50 percent, Extend III doubling the range), Shatterray (5-30, 20 structure points, the 12-dice and 60-point caps), Wall of Water (50x20, the five-hit-dice floor), Beam of Blasting (one per Gold Piece to 50, doubling at twelfth level, no living matter), Conjure Djinn/Efreet (the 24-hour service, the efreet banish-or-attack), Density Control (gas to steel, armor class one, hands as swords), Combine I (seven spell levels or three spells), Call Spirit (two questions, 25 percent floor, night only, 20 feet), Rust Monster Touch - plus the editor doctrine (the careful approval, the every-spell-needs-a-loophole rule). The list ends level 6 with cont pg 21 - levels 7-9 NEVER printed in TD18, the watch riding to TD 19. CHAIN TWO, Monkish Weapons and Monk vs Monk Combat by Garry Eckert (print 23-24, PDF 25-26): the kedo combat matrix - nine attacker moves down, nine defender moves across, the outcome codes blocked 0, cut 1, dla 2, dra 3, ara 4, ala 5 and the odd dar 6 - with the print catches pinned as scanned: the numbered attack list prints 2-8 while claiming eight attacks (attack 1 never prints, presumably the migi-do that appears only in the matrix), the dar at the migi-men vs hidari-men crossing is a transposition of dra absent from the printed notes key, and the migi-men, migi-do, gyaku-do, kote, hidari-kote and tsuki rows cut against their own defense (the six diagonal breaks) while the migi-do and gyaku-do blocked cells print crossed; the weapon doctrine - the live blade, shimia and bokutois swords, the seven-foot kyudo bow at 40-50 pounds with the 90-pound expert draw and 39-inch arrows fired standing, crouching or on horseback, the naginata and its three cuts, the seven-to-nine-foot yari, the six-foot rokushakubo, the kama sickle, the ton-fa or tui-fa in pairs, the silk-or-chain nunchaku, the sai - and the seven-rank progression from the four-weapon Novice to the 90-pound North Wind bow. CHAIN THREE, Effective Use of Poison by Bill Coburn (print 24, PDF 26): the A/B/C grid - the A potion (arsenic, hemlock, 80 percent death in 2-8 turns, stricken one week), the B gas and darts (neurotoxic, 50 percent in 4-16 turns, stricken 1-3 days, unconscious in 30 minutes for 1-4 days), the C creatures (hemotoxic, 10 percent in 1-4 days, stricken 1-10 days, unconscious in one hour for 2-8 days), the stricken halves (Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Movement), the armor saving-throw ladder +2/+1/0/-2 with the no-internal-effect rule, and the Neutralize Poison cancellation. The pin IS the conversion noted never silent; the as-scanned quirks ride the comments and the transcripts.

banner.provenance: Pinned from The Dragon Vol. III No. 4 (September 1978), the Curtiss-provided scan voice (single voice: the issue-18 source is the uploaded Dm18.pdf with its mistral-ocr transcript; no archive.org djvu cross-check exists for issue 18). PRINT FOLIO = PDF PAGE MINUS TWO, verified at the page feet in the R934 intake (folios 3, 9, 13, 14, 19, 21, 24 and 31 print at the PDF pages 5, 11, 15, 16, 21, 23, 26 and 33); this round pins print 13 (PDF 15), print 23-24 (PDF 25-26) and print 24 (PDF 26).
banner.sentinel: Print quirks pinned AS SCANNED, noted never silent: the kedo attack list prints 2-8 while claiming eight attacks - attack 1 never prints, and the migi-do row appears only in the matrix (presumably the missing attack 1); the kedo notes key prints dla, dra, ara, ala, x and the dash but the matrix carries one dar - a transposition of dra at the migi-men vs hidari-men crossing, pinned as printed; the migi-men, migi-do, gyaku-do, kote, hidari-kote and tsuki diagonal cells print as cuts (six diagonal breaks, pinned as printed) and the migi-do and gyaku-do blocked cells print crossed against each other; the G.M./North Wind rank prints the doubled word bowbow; the poison units print as scanned - the A and B death in turns, the C death in days, the A stricken week pinned as 7 days and the C one-hour delay pinned as 60 minutes; the Sullin spell list ends level 6 with cont pg 21 but the levels 7-9 NEVER printed in TD18 - the watch rides to TD 19; no numeric cell garbles beyond that, so the only sentinel cells are the three never-printed poison A unconscious entries.

tables.name: mknKedo
tables.audit_comment: the kedo combat matrix - nine attacker moves down, nine defender moves across, the outcome codes: blocked 0, cut 1, dla 2, dra 3, ara 4, ala 5 and the odd dar 6; the six diagonal breaks (migi-men, migi-do, gyaku-do, kote, hidari-kote and tsuki cut against their own defense) and the crossed migi-do/gyaku-do blocked cells pin as printed, noted never silent (print 24, PDF 26)
col_comments: the defender shomen column - blocked 0, dla 2, dra 3, cut 1, cut 1, dra 3, cut 1, cut 1, blocked 0 down the nine attacker moves (print 24, PDF 26)
the defender hidari-men column - the attacker left arm 5, blocked 0, the odd dar 6, dra 3, cut 1, dra 3, cut 1, cut 1, cut 1 (print 24, PDF 26)
the defender migi-men column - ara 4, ara 4, cut 1, ara 4, dra 3, cut 1, cut 1, cut 1, cut 1 - the migi-men row crossing is a cut, one of the six diagonal breaks pinned as printed (print 24, PDF 26)

the defender migi-do column - cut 1, dra 3, dra 3, cut 1, blocked 0, dra 3, dra 3, cut 1, cut 1 - the migi-do row crossing is a cut, one of the six diagonal breaks, and its blocked cell prints crossed into the gyaku-do column (print 24, PDF 26)

the defender gyaku-do column - cut 1, cut 1, ara 4, blocked 0, cut 1, dra 3, dra 3, cut 1, cut 1 - the gyaku-do row crossing is a cut, one of the six diagonal breaks pinned as printed (print 24, PDF 26)
the defender kote column - ara 4, ara 4, cut 1, ara 4, ara 4, cut 1, cut 1, cut 1, blocked 0 - the kote row crossing is a cut, one of the six diagonal breaks pinned as printed (print 24, PDF 26)
the defender hidari-kote column - cut 1, cut 1, cut 1, ara 4, ara 4, cut 1, cut 1, blocked 0, blocked 0 (print 24, PDF 26)
the defender tsuki column - cut 1, cut 1, cut 1, cut 1, cut 1, cut 1, blocked 0, blocked 0, blocked 0 (print 24, PDF 26)
the defender front-block column - blocked 0, cut 1, cut 1, cut 1, cut 1, cut 1, blocked 0, blocked 0, blocked 0 (print 24, PDF 26)

tables.name: mknPois
tables.audit_comment: the effective-use-of-poison grid - the A potion, B gas/darts and C creature rows with the death percent, the death timing (A and B in turns, C in days, pinned as printed), the stricken span (the A week pinned as 7 days) and the unconscious delay and duration (the A row rides the sentinel, the C one-hour delay pinned as 60 minutes) (print 24, PDF 26)
col_comments: the death percentage - 80, 50 and 10 down the A, B, C rows (print 24, PDF 26)
the death timing minimum - A and B in turns (2 and 4), C in days (1), the units pinned as printed (print 24, PDF 26)
the death timing maximum - A and B in turns (8 and 16), C in days (4) (print 24, PDF 26)
the stricken minimum - A one week pinned as 7 days noted never silent, B and C one day (print 24, PDF 26)
the stricken maximum - A 7 days, B 3 days, C 10 days (print 24, PDF 26)
the unconscious delay in minutes - A never prints an unconscious time and rides the sentinel, B 30 minutes, C one hour pinned as 60 minutes (print 24, PDF 26)
the unconscious duration minimum in days - A rides the sentinel, B 1, C 2 (print 24, PDF 26)
the unconscious duration maximum in days - A rides the sentinel, B 4, C 8 (print 24, PDF 26)
